content:
Erin: quick check — I'm about to kick off a fallback-batching run combining fused-ops + paged-attn on perf-cluster-3. Goal: confirm no regression in p90 for long-seq (1k) workloads. Can folks confirm config and blockers?

jasper: SGTM. Which config file? is this the new fallback path from PR #4821?

Erin: yes PR #4821 — fallback batching path + kernel patch. Using bench config: `bench/fused_paged_fallback.yaml` (batch_size=8, dynamic_batching=on, kv_cache=prefix).

leo: ping me when it's up, I'll attach nvtx traces. Want to check hotpath for fused op switch. Expected baseline p90 ~ 32ms, target < 36ms (no regression).

Erin: noted. Command I'm running:```./tools/run_bench --config bench/fused_paged_fallback.yaml --seq 1024 --runs 200 --profile nvtx --tag fallback-2026-03-16```

dina: Can we include a canary with quantized variant? If fallback triggers, we need to confirm output parity with fp16. Also add short eval (100 prompts) to check generation drift.

Erin: adding quant canary. Will run two parallel jobs: fallback-fp16 and fallback-8bit. Putting them on separate GPUs.

deploy-bot: job queued: id=j-2247, cluster=perf-cluster-3, nodes=2, owner=Erin — scheduled start in ~2m. Logs: https://perf.redwood.example/jobs/j-2247

jasper: FYI I pushed a tiny harness tweak (`bench/harness.py`) to dump per-op timings. PR #4830 — comment in the run config: `dump_op_timing: true`

Erin: great, i've toggled that. Also enabling `kv_prefetch: true` to mimic production traffic.

leo: when the run finishes, can someone grab the kernel traces and nvprof flamegraphs? i'll correlate with op timings for the fused->paged transition.

dina: if we see p95 spikes, check KV eviction spikes — earlier run showed an eviction cliff at ~120s into long sequences. Add `kv_stats_interval: 10s`

qa-bot: pre-run checks OK: deps pinned, GPU drivers 535.*, free memory >= 48GB per node.

deploy-bot: job started: j-2247 -> nodes: node-a4,node-a8. Streaming logs: https://perf.redwood.example/logs/j-2247/stream

Erin: running now. I'll post quick results here (p90/p95 + regression flag). If green, can we cut a canary tag and request a small dedicated run next week?

jasper: copy. If you see a small increase (<5%) it's acceptable but annotate the cause (batch alignment, new kernel loop). Any >10% we stop and bisect.

leo: also enable `--sample-ids 123,456,789` so we can reproduce traces for the same sequences.

Erin: added sample ids. run is ~35% through first job, will post intermediate p90 in ~20m.

(20m later)

Erin: intermediate: fallback-fp16 p90=34.1ms (+6%), p95=58.2ms. fallback-8bit p90=35.9ms (+12%) — 8bit looks like it regresses more on p95. nvtx shows a brief stall during fused->paged switch at step ~47.

leo: can you upload the nvtx slice and op timings? link them here.

Erin: uploaded: https://perf.redwood.example/artifacts/j-2247/nvtx_fallback_slice.json and op timings: https://perf.redwood.example/artifacts/j-2247/op_timing.csv

jasper: looking — the op_timing shows `fused_attention_switch` spike at 1.1s (single-call latency). I suspect an extra memcpy on the 8bit path. I'll grep the kernel patch.

dina: re: output parity, small eval passed 99.6% token match for fp16, 98.2% for 8bit. 8bit diffs concentrated in rare tokens.

leo: ok, plan: jasper to check memcpy, erin to run a dedicated 8bit microbench with batch=1..16 to see scaling, dina to run longer eval (1k prompts) if microbench is acceptable. If we pin the memcpy, we can land PR #4821 with a canary flag.

Erin: sounds good. tagging @release for canary decision when we have microbench results.

deploy-bot: job j-2247 completed: status=partial-success (fp16 green, 8bit p95 regressed). Artifacts uploaded.

Erin: thanks all. jasper — want to pair on the memcpy check in 30m?

jasper: yep, ping me in #devex if you need a meeting. I'll start a quick local repro. :thumbsup:
